answer_result.answer: Calvin's concert in Tokyo was in May 2023, specifically the week before 2023-05-31 (approximately 2023-05-22 to 2023-05-28).

question.question: When was Calvin's concert in Tokyo?

evidence_items.text:
Calvin: Thanks, Dave! I'm so excited you'll be at one of our shows. It's such a great experience, you'll definitely enjoy it! Look at this crowd, that was insane!
[Image caption: a photo of a large crowd of people in a large auditorium]
[S24T7] (dia_id: D24:7)

Dave: That sounds really exciting! Can't wait to experience it. I'm sure everyone in the crowd is going to be pumped up!
[S24T8] (dia_id: D24:8)

Calvin: Wow, the crowd energy is amazing! It always gets me so pumped and it's awesome. Look at that photo, that was awesome!
[Image caption: a photography of a crowd of people at a concert with their hands in the air]
[S24T9] (dia_id: D24:9)

Dave: Wow, Calvin, that's an awesome pic! Everyone looks so pumped. Where was that taken?
[S24T10] (dia_id: D24:10)

Calvin: Thanks, Dave! That pic was taken in Tokyo during a concert. Man, the energy was nuts - felt like the whole city came out!
[S24T11] (dia_id: D24:11)

Dave: Wow, Calvin, Tokyo looks incredible! Here's a pic I found online, and it's making me dream about visiting someday. The energy there seems unbeatable! Have you ever visited streets like that?
[Image caption: a photo of a busy street with people walking and shopping]
[S24T12] (dia_id: D24:12)

Calvin: Yes, Dave! That was an incredible experience to visit similar streets like you shared in your photo. Is there anything else that interests you in Tokyo?
[S24T13] (dia_id: D24:13)

Dave: Of course, Calvin! Tokyo is amazing! I want to know everything about it - the people, the culture, the food, take a walk at the vibrant city life! In the photo below, the city is so alive and colorful that's impressive! It will be an unforgettable experience!
[Image caption: a photo of a crowded street at night with people walking and walking]
[S24T14] (dia_id: D24:14)

Calvin: That photo's a great pic! The lights, the people - so lively! Can't wait to hear your emotions when you see that in person!
[S24T15] (dia_id: D24:15)

Dave: It's really amazing. Hope I'll get to see it in person soon!
[S24T16] (dia_id: D24:16)

Calvin: Cool, Dave! I'm actually going to Tokyo next month after the tour ends. Sometimes I wish I could go back to places like the one in the photo below. What a great view!
[Image caption: a photo of a city at night with a tall building in the background]
[S24T17] (dia_id: D24:17)

Dave: Wow, Calvin! That's great to hear! Any specific spots in Tokyo that you're really excited to check out?
[S24T18] (dia_id: D24:18)

Calvin: Yeah definitely! Shibuya Crossing is like Tokyo's Times Square, and I was excited to explore Shinjuku. Plus, there's amazing food there, can't wait to try it again! Look at the photo of Shibuya Crossing at night, that's amazing!
[Image caption: a photo of a crowd of people with umbrellas in the rain]
[S24T19] (dia_id: D24:19)

Dave: Shibuya and Shinjuku are cool spots! The food in Tokyo is great, I'll have so much fun exploring all the different places. Have you tried ramen yet? Here's a photo of a ramen bowl that I tried in Boston, it was delicious, but i think in Tokyo it will be even better!
[Image caption: a photo of a bowl of soup with broccoli and noodles]
[S24T20] (dia_id: D24:20)

Calvin: Thanks, Dave! Never tried it, but it's supposed to be awesome. Gonna give it a shot while in Tokyo!
[S24T21] (dia_id: D24:21)

Dave: Do it, Calvin! Once you try it, you'll never go back. Bon voyage and have fun!
[S24T22] (dia_id: D24:22)

- As of 2023-05-31, he had been touring with Frank Ocean the week before (~2023-05-22/28) and called it "wild"; the Tokyo show was "unreal" — the crowd was "insane" — and performing "felt so alive" he "can't find the words to express it"; the energy and love from the fans was "crazy" [S7T1][S7T3]. This was the Frank Ocean tour his planned Boston trip was to follow (see the Boston trip section below); as of 2023-05-31, Boston is a stop on this tour itself.
- On 2023-08-14, updated Dave that the tour with the well-known artist (the Frank Ocean tour, see above) ended with a show in Japan — the Tokyo show was "awesome": everyone was "so into it" when he played one of his songs and sang along, which he called "a magical moment"; feeling of performing and connecting with the audience "was unreal"; after the tour he had the opportunity to explore his new place (the Japanese mansion, see ## New home (2023-03-23)) — "it's like a dream come true!" [S14T4][S14T6].
- On 2023-08-31, when Dave asked how the end of the tour was, Calvin said the tour was amazing — he was "so pumped from all the energy from the audience" — and shared a photo of a crowd watching a concert with a large screen ("This pic totally captures how I felt. Such an amazing time!"); when Dave asked how it was performing on that big stage, Calvin said it was "a dream come true" — the energy was incredible, he "felt on top of the world", and it was "seriously surreal" [S16T2][S16T3][S16T4].
- On 2023-10-19, told Dave he has started touring with Frank Ocean ("lots happened" since they last talked) — "it's been amazing": so much energy from the crowd and "such a connection when I'm on stage — unreal!"; the tour "has been great" and "jamming with Frank Ocean is a dream come true" (another Frank Ocean tour after the earlier ones listed here — Dave is looking forward to attending one of its shows, see the 2023-10-19 entry in ## Relationships) [S24T1][S24T3].
- On 2023-10-19, shared another photo of the tour crowd: a crowd of people at a concert with their hands in the air — "Wow, the crowd energy is amazing! It always gets me so pumped and it's awesome. Look at that photo, that was awesome!"; when Dave asked where it was taken, Calvin said it was taken in Tokyo during a concert — "the energy was nuts - felt like the whole city came out!" (Dave's enthusiasm about visiting Tokyo, see /memories/dave.md > ## Japan) [S24T9][S24T10][S24T11].
- On 2023-10-19, announced he's actually going to Tokyo in November 2023 ("next month") after the tour ends — shared a photo of a city at night with a tall building in the background ("What a great view!") and said "Sometimes I wish I could go back to places like [that]"; spots he's excited to check out: Shibuya Crossing — "like Tokyo's Times Square" — and Shinjuku; he can't wait to try the amazing food there again (shared a photo of Shibuya Crossing at night — a crowd of people with umbrellas in the rain); he has never tried ramen but "it's supposed to be awesome" — "Gonna give it a shot while in Tokyo!" — after Dave (who tried ramen in Boston) encouraged him (Dave's side in /memories/dave.md > ## Japan) [S24T17][S24T19][S24T21].

Calvin: Hey Dave! Long time no see. I just went to an awesome music thingy in Tokyo - so cool!
[S3T1] (dia_id: D3:1)

Dave: Hey Calvin! Great to hear from you. How was the music thingy in Tokyo? See any cool bands?
[S3T2] (dia_id: D3:2)

Calvin: Hey Dave! The festival in Tokyo was awesome! Didn't see any bands, but met lots of talented artists and industry people. Totally enriching!
[S3T3] (dia_id: D3:3)

Dave: Wow, Calvin, sounds great! What did you learn from it?
[S3T4] (dia_id: D3:4)

Calvin: I learned a lot and got some great advice from professionals in the music industry. It was inspiring!
[S3T5] (dia_id: D3:5)

Dave: Wow, Calvin! Bet that was inspiring being surrounded by professionals. Did you get any advice from them?
[S3T6] (dia_id: D3:6)

evidence_items.speaker: Calvin
evidence_items.text:
- On 2023-08-03, said his plan for now (when Dave asked for his biggest goal) is to expand his brand worldwide and grow his fanbase — "I want my music to reach more people and make an impact" — and working with artists from around the globe and challenging himself to create special music are goals of his too (an extension of his earlier world-tour dream, see above) [S12T11].
- On 2023-08-03, shared a photo of performing with his band "the boys" the night before (2023-08-02) — a photo of a band playing on stage with lights on — "they are great at the music!" [S12T11].
- On 2023-08-14, when Dave asked for pictures from the show, shared a photo from the tour's closing show in Tokyo (details in ## Tokyo trip (2023-04-20)): a crowd of people at the concert with their hands up — "It was so awesome - I loved how the crowd was into it. These moments are why I love my job." [S14T8].
- On 2023-08-14, said the tour's closing show was "buzzing" — "It's moments like these that make me so proud and motivated" — and that he's "all about spreading joy with my art" [S14T10].
- As of 2023-08-22, scored a deal to continue collaborating with Frank Ocean and recorded a song in the studio at his mansion (details in ## Frank Ocean collaboration) [S15T2][S15T4].

Calvin: Thanks, Dave! Can't wait to get back to making music. Anything exciting you're working on these days?
[S6T7] (dia_id: D6:7)

Dave: I'm so excited, I opened my car shop last week! Invited some friends over to celebrate and it's been amazing. Super stoked to share my passion and help out with folks' rides. It's been incredible so far.
[S6T8] (dia_id: D6:8)

Calvin: Way to go, Dave! Congrats on opening your own car shop! Your excitement is contagious. Keep up the great work!
[S6T9] (dia_id: D6:9)

Dave: Thanks, Calvin! Your support is greatly appreciated. It's been quite a journey so far, and I'm excited to see what the future holds. How about you? Anything exciting happening in the world of music for you?
[S6T10] (dia_id: D6:10)

Calvin: Thanks Dave! Super excited for my upcoming performance in Tokyo this month. It's gonna be great to show my music to a whole new crowd and hopefully expand my following!
[S6T11] (dia_id: D6:11)

Dave: Cool, Cal! Doing a show in Tokyo, wow! I'm sure the audience is gonna love it. Wishing you all the luck! Let me know how it goes.
[S6T12] (dia_id: D6:12)

Calvin: Sure thing, Dave! I'll keep you posted on how it goes. Thanks for the good luck! Look what a wonderful night! 

[Image caption: a photo of a city at night with a lot of lights]
[S6T13] (dia_id: D6:13)

Dave: That looks great! Where did you snap that pic?
[S6T14] (dia_id: D6:14)

Calvin: I took that pic in Tokyo last night. The skyline was stunning!
[S6T15] (dia_id: D6:15)

Dave: Wow, great shot! The night skyline really pops with those city lights. I gotta take a trip there soon!
[S6T16] (dia_id: D6:16)

- The 2023-08-11 conversation continued: Calvin praised Dave's attention to detail on the car mod project — "You've really put in some work! That attention to detail is great" — agreed the small details are what make a masterpiece unique and personalized, and told Dave his "enthusiasm and hard work show in everything you do", encouraging him to "keep coming up with new cool stuff, bud" and saying he's excited to see what Dave will do next (Dave's car project details in /memories/dave.md > ## Car mod workshop (2023-08-11)) [S13T10][S13T12][S13T14]. Dave offered Calvin a hand with his music stuff — his music studio has a high-quality sound system (details in the Music section of /memories/dave.md); Calvin thanked him, said he's "super busy with my music stuff at the moment" and will keep the offer in mind, and closed "Great work, dude!" [S13T15][S13T16].
- The 2023-08-11 conversation ended with Dave wishing Calvin good luck with his music, Calvin thanking Dave for the encouragement and saying he'll keep working hard and making music, and the two signing off ("Take care!" / "See ya, Calvin! Stay awesome. Catch ya later.") [S13T17][S13T18][S13T19].
- On 2023-08-14, reconnected with Dave ("since last we talked"): Calvin told him the amazing experience of touring with the well-known artist — the tour ended with a show in Japan, and afterward he got to explore his new place, "like a dream come true" (the Japanese mansion, see ## New home (2023-03-23)); Calvin: "It's always great to learn and grow", and asked what Dave had been up to [S14T1][S14T2][S14T3][S14T4]. Dave bet playing for an eager audience was incredible and asked how Tokyo reacted and about special moments; Calvin said the Tokyo show was "awesome" — everyone was "so into it" when he played one of his songs and sang along, "a magical moment" (details in ## Tokyo trip (2023-04-20)); when Dave asked for pictures from the show, Calvin shared a photo (a crowd at the concert with their hands up), saying these moments are why he loves his job (photo in ## Music); Dave: "The energy in that pic is awesome! ... It's great when your passion brings joy to others!" [S14T5][S14T6][S14T7][S14T8][S14T9].
- The 2023-08-14 conversation continued: Calvin asked how Dave's car restoration project was going; Dave said it's "going great" and shared a photo of the car (a car with a broken engine in the woods) (details in /memories/dave.md, Car mod workshop section); Calvin predicted the car "is going to look amazing when you're done" and asked how long the restore would take, and Calvin said it was "buzzing" to see the crowd — "It's moments like these that make me so proud and motivated" [S14T10][S14T11][S14T12].
- The 2023-08-14 conversation closed with Calvin cheering Dave on: "You got this, Dave! I'm always here for you. Seeing your enthusiasm is amazing. Keep growing, buddy. It'll be worth it! Good luck with that. See ya!" [S14T16].

Calvin: Hey Dave! Been ages since we chatted. So much has gone down. Touring with Frank Ocean last week was wild. Tokyo was unreal -- the crowd was insane. I felt so alive when performing, can't find the words to express it.
[S7T1] (dia_id: D7:1)

Dave: Wow, that's awesome, Cal! I bet it was an incredible experience. Congrats! Look what I've been up to recently, that's my neighbor's car. He's been having some trouble with the engine, but now it's done by myself!
[Image caption: a photo of a man working on a car engine in a garage]
[S7T2] (dia_id: D7:2)

Calvin: Thanks, Dave! It was an amazing experience - the energy and love from the fans was crazy. The car in the pic? It's the one you were fixing up the engine for a friend? Working on cars helps me chill and clear my head.
[S7T3] (dia_id: D7:3)

Dave: Yes, Cal! It's not difficult for me to help my neighbors with their cars. Working on cars is definitely therapeutic. Does it relax you as much as it does me?
[S7T4] (dia_id: D7:4)

Calvin: Yeah, totally! Fixing cars really calms me down and gives me a real sense of achievement - like meditating. Do you have any hobbies that give you the same satisfaction?
[S7T5] (dia_id: D7:5)

Dave: I'm passionate about fixing up things. It's more than just a hobby - it gives me a sense of achievement and purpose. I get a real buzz transforming something that's not working into something that runs smoothly - it's like giving it a second chance.
[S7T6] (dia_id: D7:6)

- As of 2023-07-07, has never been to Japan but is "so keen to go one day"; he's heard it's "full of vibes, good eats and awesome tech", and thinks experiencing the culture would be amazing — he's "hooked on" Japanese music [S10T11].
- Builds on his earlier interest: after seeing Calvin's Tokyo night-skyline photo (2023-05-16), he said he has to take a trip to Tokyo soon and is "definitely adding it to [his] list" (noted under ## Relationships) [S6T16][S6T18].
- On 2023-10-19, shown Calvin's photo of a concert crowd in Tokyo (hands in the air), reacted with "Wow, Calvin, that's an awesome pic! Everyone looks so pumped. Where was that taken?"; Calvin confirmed it was taken in Tokyo during a concert ("the energy was nuts - felt like the whole city came out!"); Dave then shared a photo of a busy street with people walking and shopping (found online) — "Tokyo looks incredible! Here's a pic I found online, and it's making me dream about visiting someday. The energy there seems unbeatable!" — and asked whether Calvin had ever visited streets like that; Calvin: yes, visiting similar streets "was an incredible experience." When Calvin asked what else interests him in Tokyo, Dave said he wants to know "everything about it - the people, the culture, the food, take a walk at the vibrant city life!" (shared a photo of a crowded street at night — "the city is so alive and colorful that's impressive! It will be an unforgettable experience!"), and said "It's really amazing. Hope I'll get to see it in person soon!" (Calvin: "Can't wait to hear your emotions when you see that in person!") — a concrete update on his long-standing dream of visiting Tokyo, see above [S24T10][S24T11][S24T12][S24T13][S24T14][S24T15][S24T16].
- On 2023-10-19, shared a photo of a bowl of ramen he tried in Boston (a bowl of soup with broccoli and noodles) — "it was delicious, but in Tokyo it will be even better!" — encouraging Calvin (who has never tried it) to "give it a shot" in Tokyo — "Once you try it, you'll never go back. Bon voyage and have fun!" (Calvin's November 2023 Tokyo trip, see /memories/calvin.md > ## Tokyo trip (2023-04-20)) [S24T20][S24T22].

Calvin: I'm so excited to learn about Japanese culture and get a chance to expand.
[S1T5] (dia_id: D1:5)

Dave: Wow, Calvin, learning about new cultures is awesome! Have you ever been to Japan?
[S1T6] (dia_id: D1:6)

Calvin: Never been there before. Fascinated by the traditions and can't wait to get a taste of the culture.
[S1T7] (dia_id: D1:7)

Dave: Wow, Japan sounds amazing. Can't wait to hear all about it! When are you leaving?
[S1T8] (dia_id: D1:8)

Calvin: I'm heading there next month. I'll be staying in such a nice place while I'm there.


[Image caption: a photo of a living room with a couch, table, and television]
[S1T9] (dia_id: D1:9)

Dave: That looks cozy! Where'd you find a place to stay there?
[S1T10] (dia_id: D1:10)

Calvin: Wow, my agent found me this awesome place, so thankful!
[S1T11] (dia_id: D1:11)

Dave: Awesome! Having a place to stay is key. What are your plans for the trip?
[S1T12] (dia_id: D1:12)

Calvin: I'm planning to explore the city, try out different local cuisines, and perhaps collaborate with musicians in the area.
[S1T13] (dia_id: D1:13)

Dave: Sounds great! Collaborating with local musicians would be an amazing experience. How long are you planning to stay in Japan?
[S1T14] (dia_id: D1:14)

evidence_items.section: # Calvin > ## Boston trip (planned as of 2023-04-20; Frank Ocean tour stop as of 2023-05-31; personal visit July 2023)
evidence_items.text:
- As of 2023-05-31, the Boston visit is part of the Frank Ocean tour: "Cool, can't wait for the tour with Frank!" — he's "buzzing to perform in Boston and see what it's like" and "Gonna be great playing for folks from home" (calling Boston's folks "from home" suggests it is where he's from, though not stated outright). He asked Dave what he thinks of the music scene there; Dave: it's "awesome — Tons of talented musicians and cool places to play," and he'll be there to cheer Calvin on (details in /memories/dave.md > ## Boston) [S7T15][S7T16].
- On 2023-06-09, said he has never been to Boston before but has heard the parks are amazing — "can't wait to visit next month" (i.e., July 2023); he wants to take walks in the Boston parks to experience their serenity and recharge, and asked Dave what cool things he remembers about them; shared a photo of a tree with pink flowers (likely from the album session); Dave's recollections of the Boston parks are in /memories/dave.md > ## Boston [S8T5][S8T7].
- As of 2023-08-22, said his tour ends soon and he's heading to Boston, and proposed meeting up with Dave then — "Maybe we can meet up then!" (renewing the earlier plan to meet in Boston, see above); Dave: "Fill me in on the details when you have them and let's meet up when you're here. Can't wait to hear all about everything!" (Note: the 2023-08-14 update described the Frank Ocean tour as already having ended with the Tokyo show, so this "tour ends soon" may be a continuation or a new tour — unconfirmed) [S15T10][S15T11].
- On 2023-09-02, told Dave he booked a flight to Boston "last week" (~2023-08-26 through 09-01) and is "so excited" about the upcoming Boston trip, sharing a photo of a book with a boarding pass on it — "See you soon, buddy!"; he'll let Dave know when he's in Boston, and Dave told him to let him know when he's free so they can catch up in Boston (continuing the plan to meet up in Boston, see above) [S17T6][S17T7][S17T8]. The chat closed with Dave: "Looking forward to seeing you! Have a safe trip, see ya!"; Calvin thanked Dave, reciprocated the safe-trip wishes ("Gotta stay safe on the trip"), said "Can't wait to see you there!", and promised he will contact Dave when he arrives [S17T9][S17T10].
- On 2023-09-13, re-pledged the plan to let Dave know when he's in Boston — "I'll let you know when I'm in Boston" — and accepted Dave's offer to check out his garage and its cool cars (Dave shared a photo of the garage — a car in a garage with a Coca-Cola sign — "looks stunning!"), saying it would be fun and might give him ideas for future projects (details in ## Relationships; Dave's side in /memories/dave.md > ## Boston) [S18T11][S18T12].
